rubrics.justification: Describes a good-quality blastocyst with thinned intact zona, reassuring ICM and cohesive TE, and appropriately notes limits of a single image. Minor issue: it questions the reported 3AA vs expanded terminology rather than simply reconciling lab grading conventions.
Strong integration of age, ovarian response, FSH, BMI, endometrium, male-factor context, first-cycle status, and smoking with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logical and well-structured, with probability estimate tied to morphology and patient factors. Small inconsistency in discussing Gardner stage nomenclature and some speculative emphasis on unresolved male factor despite reassuring semen parameters.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice: single embryo transfer, luteal support, smoking cessation, no bed rest, individualized PGT-A discussion. Minor deviations include somewhat imprecise staging commentary and broad suggestions not strictly guideline-driven.
Provides clear next steps for current transfer and contingency planning after failure, including lifestyle changes, medication adherence, and targeted future evaluations.
